sample_unit: ChatGPT-4o responses (5 questions x 3 simultaneous responses)

links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT-4o responses to identical COPD prompts entered simultaneously
links.effect: Simultaneous responses to identical prompts differed materially in accuracy and potential clinical impact; for two questions one response was rated more useful than the others; consensus in 40 of 45 ratings (88.9%).
links.quote: Simultaneous ChatGPT-4o responses to identical COPD prompts differed materially in accuracy and potential clinical impact.

links.outcome: Whether ChatGPT-4o COPD pharmacotherapy answers relied on current guidelines
links.effect: For one stable COPD pharmacotherapy question, all 3 simultaneous responses cited a retired clinical practice guideline, resulting in poor accuracy ratings.
links.quote: For one question on stable COPD pharmacotherapy, all 3 simultaneous responses cited a retired clinical practice guideline, resulting in poor accuracy ratings.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy, usefulness, and consistency/variability of ChatGPT-4o responses to COPD clinical scenarios using a modified Delphi method with clinical pharmacists, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
